name: numeric_answer annual salary label gets year digits
spec_quote: when the label (case-insensitive) has a whole word "annual", "yearly", "per year", "a year", "annum" or "salary" → ("52000", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer hourly rate label gets hour digits
spec_quote: otherwise → ("25", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer 'per year' phrase matches
spec_quote: when the label (case-insensitive) has a whole word ... "per year", "a year" ... → ("52000", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer 'a year' phrase matches
spec_quote: when the label (case-insensitive) has a whole word ... "a year" ... → ("52000", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer 'annum' matched case-insensitively
spec_quote: when the label (case-insensitive) has a whole word ... "annum" ... → ("52000", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer 'salaried' is not whole word 'salary'
spec_quote: when the label (case-insensitive) has a whole word ... "salary" → ("52000", "rules:comp (digits)"); otherwise → ("25", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer 'annually' is not whole word 'annual'
spec_quote: when the label (case-insensitive) has a whole word "annual" ... → ("52000" ...); otherwise → ("25", "rules:comp (digits)")

name: numeric_answer non-comp source returns null with number box reason
spec_quote: any other src → (None, a reason string that starts with "number box:").

name: state_on_review Illinois with matching code zip
spec_quote: True when txt contains a comma, optional spaces, that code in CAPITALS, and then either spaces plus a 5-digit ZIP (optionally -4 digits) or the end of a line. Example: "Chicago, IL 60601" → True for "Illinois".

name: state_on_review lowercase value with ZIP+4
spec_quote: A State answer written as the full U.S. state name (any case, extra spaces allowed, e.g. "Illinois", "new york") is shown ... as its two-letter postal code ... True when txt contains a comma, optional spaces, that code in CAPITALS, and then either spaces plus a 5-digit ZIP (optionally -4 digits)...

name: state_on_review code followed by end of line
spec_quote: True when txt contains a comma, optional spaces, that code in CAPITALS, and then either spaces plus a 5-digit ZIP (optionally -4 digits) or the end of a line.

name: state_on_review zero spaces after comma
spec_quote: True when txt contains a comma, optional spaces, that code in CAPITALS...

name: state_on_review wrong code is false
spec_quote: A different code (", IN 46000" for Illinois) → False.

name: state_on_review non-US-state value is false
spec_quote: A value that is not a U.S. state name (e.g. "Ontario", "IL", "") → False.

name: state_on_review abbreviation value is false
spec_quote: A value that is not a U.S. state name (e.g. "Ontario", "IL", "") → False.

name: block_kind_of language takes precedence over education
spec_quote: Checked in this order, case-insensitive: contains "language" → "languages"; contains "educat"...

name: block_kind_of schools attended is education
spec_quote: contains "educat", "academic" or the whole word "school"/"schools" → "education". Examples: "Schools Attended 2" → education

name: block_kind_of academic experience is education before work
spec_quote: contains "educat", "academic" or the whole word "school"/"schools" → "education"... Examples: ... "Academic Experience 1" → education

name: block_kind_of worked section is work
spec_quote: contains "work", "experience" or "employment" → "work". Examples: ... "Where have you worked? 3" → work.

name: block_kind_of unrelated section is null
spec_quote: contains "work", "experience" or "employment" → "work"; else None.

name: blocks_of counts distinct numbered language sections
spec_quote: The number of DISTINCT sections that end in a number (optional trailing spaces) and whose block_kind_of is `kind`.

name: blocks_of duplicate section counted once
spec_quote: The number of DISTINCT sections that end in a number (optional trailing spaces) and whose block_kind_of is `kind`.

name: blocks_of section without trailing number not a block
spec_quote: Sections without a trailing number are not blocks.

name: blocks_of counts work-kind sections only
spec_quote: The number of DISTINCT sections that end in a number (optional trailing spaces) and whose block_kind_of is `kind`.

name: ready dry-run status with only dry-run reason
spec_quote: False unless status == "dry-run". Then True when every reason is "dry-run"...

name: ready dry-run status with no reasons is true
spec_quote: Then True when every reason is ...

name: ready reason starting with batch not approved is allowed
spec_quote: Then True when every reason is "dry-run", "batch not approved", starts with "batch not approved"...

name: ready singular DeepSeek answer reason is allowed
spec_quote: matches "<digits> DeepSeek answer(s) to spot-check…" (also "answer" / "answers" without "(s)")

name: ready review page lacks reason is false
spec_quote: Any other reason (e.g. "review page lacks: …", "problems: …") → False.

name: ready non-dry-run status is false even with dry-run reason
spec_quote: False unless status == "dry-run".
